# Wanderlust Designers

> > Travel guides and itinerary planning by Filip and Šárka covering Japan, Patagonia, Italy, Cambodia, and worldwide adventures.

Wanderlust Designers is a travel blog created by Filip and Šárka, offering detailed destination guides, cultural insights, and practical trip planning advice for adventurous travelers exploring iconic destinations from the temples of Southeast Asia to the glaciers of Patagonia.

## Key Topics

- Japan travel
- Patagonia exploration
- Italy and Sicily
- Cambodia temple tours
- Torres del Paine
- Los Glaciares National Park
- Dolomites hiking
- Southeast Asia adventures
- Itinerary planning
- Cultural tourism
- Adventure travel
- World travel guides
- Siem Reap and Angkor region
- Czech Republic perspectives

## Main Pages

- [Wanderlust Designers](https://www.wanderlustdesigners.com/home/): Homepage for travel inspiration covering Japan, Patagonia & trip planning
- [Wanderlust Designers -](https://www.wanderlustdesigners.com/): Main page featuring travel guides for Sicily, Japan, Cambodia & more
